verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents the building blocks: API-created virtual cards, transaction rules that auto-decline authorizations outside business requirements, real-time relayed authorisation, per-card balances, and suspend/close controls. These could be assembled into a policy-scoped card for an agent. Nothing in the evidence frames this as an AI-agent use case, and merchant locks, amount caps and expiry are not explicitly named as rule types. missing for 10: vendor documentation of the agent/AI use case by name, explicit merchant-lock and amount-cap rule documentation, configurable card expiry, independent or hands-on corroboration.
